name: thrift
tagline: Trims a sprawling bot fleet's token bill without changing what any bot is meant to do
description: Run enough bots and the running cost stops being trivial. This one audits the collection you have accumulated, cuts over-long instruction profiles back to the parts actually doing work, and points out the half-built ones sitting idle. Anything on a live timer is left untouched until you approve the change.
author: Mario
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
